faq.title: Everything you need to know
faq.lead: Booking, payment, cancellation and picking up the car. Can't find the answer?

items.q: Do I need an account to book?
items.a: No. Choose the car, fill in your details and get a booking code. With the code and your phone number you can find the booking under "My booking".

items.q: What is the minimum rental period?
items.a: The minimum is 3 days and the maximum 30 days.
The company that owns the car. It receives the booking instantly and contacts you by phone or email.

items.q: How do I know the car is available?
items.a: When you choose dates in the search, only available cars are shown. On the booking page you can also see the dates when the car is booked.

items.q: When and how do I pay?
items.a: You pay the company when you pick up the car. The price in the summary is the final total.

items.q: Is there a discount for long rentals?
items.a: Yes. For 7 days or more you get a 10% discount automatically.
The daily rental and the extras you choose (GPS, child seat, full insurance). Fuel is not included.

items.q: How do I cancel my booking?
items.a: Under "My booking" enter your code and phone number, then click "Cancel". Free cancellation is allowed only within 24 hours of booking and before the pick-up day.

items.q: The 24 hours have passed, what can I do?
items.a: Call the company directly (the number is on the booking) or write to us on the Help page.

items.q: How do I change the dates?
items.a: Cancel within 24 hours and make a new booking, or contact the company.
A valid driving licence and an ID document. The driver must be 21–75 years old.

items.q: Where do I pick up the car?
items.a: At the location you chose in the booking, e.g. Rinas Airport, Tirana centre, Durrës, Vlorë, Shkodër or Sarandë.

items.q: Can I return it in another city?
items.a: Yes, choose a different return location when booking. Confirm it with the company.

items.q: How does my company become a partner?
items.a: Write to us on the Help page with the topic "I want to become a partner". We add the company and its cars and create your dashboard login.

items.q: What does a business see in the dashboard?
items.a: Its own bookings, the status of its cars (available / booked) and daily, weekly and monthly revenue.

about.title: One place for every rental car in Albania
about.lead: Bookers Car Albania connects travellers with local rental companies. Compare prices, see which car is available and book in a few minutes, without an account. The company receives the booking instantly and waits for you with the car ready.
about.mission1: Renting a car in Albania often means phone calls, messages and changing prices. We make it simple: clear prices, real availability and the same rules for everyone — minimum 3 days, free cancellation within 24 hours, payment at pick-up.
about.mission2: For local companies we are an online showroom and a dashboard where they see bookings, available cars and revenue every day.
about.ctaTitle: Do you own a rental company?
about.ctaText: Join as a partner and get bookings from new customers, with your own dashboard.
